title: pop-wallet agent state
description: Per-human preferences an autonomous agent reads before driving the `pop` PoP funder wallet. Captured during onboarding (first use) and updated only with explicit human consent. Lives at ~/.pop-wallet/agent-state.json. This file is NOT a secret (it holds no keys or seed), but it encodes spending authority the agent is trusted to honor — treat changes as consequential.
$comment: pop CLI output & error contract (FROZEN, schema_version 1): JSON is the DEFAULT output of every `pop` command, on success AND failure, on stdout — exactly ONE JSON object per invocation, nothing else (all progress/poll-status/diagnostics go to stderr). `--human` (alias `--pretty`) switches to human text (success -> stdout, failure -> stderr); `--json` is a deprecated accepted no-op. Every output carries top-level "schema_version": 1. Failure shape: { "schema_version": 1, "error": { "code", "retriable", "message", "details"? } } on stdout with non-zero exit (1); clap argument-parse errors exit 2 with no envelope. Branch on `code` + `details`, never on `message`. The closed, additive-only code set and per-code retry-class + details are documented in $defs.pop_cli_error_contract below and in SKILL.md.

version.description: Schema version for this state file.

wallet_dir.description: The pop wallet directory (the dir that holds config.toml, seed, wallet.db, recovery/). Default ~/.pop-wallet. Pass to every command as --wallet-dir if not the default.

network.description: Bitcoin network the wallet was init'd on (pinned for the wallet's life; informational here — the wallet enforces it).

mnemonic_backed_up.description: Set true ONLY after the human confirms they have written down / safely stored the BIP-39 mnemonic shown once at `pop init`. The agent MUST refuse to lock real (mainnet) funds while this is false.

default_mint.description: The mint to lock against unless the human names another. mint_pubkey is REQUIRED by `pop quote/mint` on first use of a mint and is TOFU-pinned in the wallet's config.toml.

mint_pubkey.description: The mint's 33-byte compressed identity pubkey (66 hex chars). Used to independently verify the funding address — the funder's sole defense against a malicious address.

additional_mints.description: Other mints the human has approved, same shape as default_mint.

default_lock_duration.description: Default credential lifetime / CLTV term passed as `--duration` (e.g. 30d, 12h). The locked BTC is illiquid until now+duration. A bare number is days.

max_amount_sats_per_lock.description: Hard ceiling, in sats, on a single lock the agent may perform WITHOUT a fresh, explicit human approval that names the larger amount. A safety rail, not a balance.

default_recovery_dest.description: Default destination address for `pop recover --dest`. Recommended: a fresh address the human controls (recovery reveals the construction on-chain). If null, the agent MUST ask for a destination before recovering. The agent MUST always re-confirm the destination with the human before broadcasting a recovery, and MUST never recover to an unconfirmed/unverified address.

default_fee.description: Default fee policy for recovery. Omit both to let the wallet size the fee from the mempool at --target blocks.

target_blocks.description: Confirmation target for the mempool feerate estimate (`pop recover --target`).

absolute_sats.description: Absolute fee in sats (`pop recover --fee`), overrides target_blocks if set.

authorized_services.description: Forward-looking: services / marketplaces the human has authorized the agent to obtain and spend PoP ecash with (e.g. a 402-paying browser flow, an MPP marketplace). The wallet itself does NOT spend ecash (it prints a cashuB token), so this is policy the agent honors when it hands a minted token to a downstream consumer.

max_amount_sats_per_payment.description: Per-payment ceiling for this service, if the human set one.

onboarded_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when onboarding completed.

updated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the last consented change to this file.

pop_cli_error_contract.$comment: DOCUMENTATION ONLY (not a validation rule). Reference for the `pop` CLI's frozen failure envelope `{ schema_version, error: { code, retriable, message, details? } }`. retry-class is doc-only, keyed by `code`: transient = retry same call as-is (retriable:true); needs_input = fix the call / ask the human then retry; terminal = do not retry. 'details: REQ' = the listed fields are always populated.
pop_cli_error_contract.title: pop CLI error codes (FROZEN, closed, additive-only — never remove/rename a code; a breaking change bumps schema_version)

code.description: Stable lower_snake_case error code. The closed set is the enum below.

retriable.description: true iff the failure is transient (safe to retry the same call as-is). true for: mint_unreachable, chain_unreachable, funding_pending, cltv_not_expired, broadcast_failed. false for all others.

message.description: Human help only. Agents MUST NOT parse it.

details.description: Structured remediation fields; see per-code table below.

mint_unreachable.note: transient-network read side (mint unreachable); mirror of chain_unreachable

chain_unreachable.note: esplora (chain backend) GET/read transport failure — operation in {tip_mtp, utxo_fetch, fee_estimate}; transient-network read side, mirror of mint_unreachable. DISTINCT from broadcast_failed (the esplora POST/broadcast write path); a malformed esplora body stays internal_error

cltv_not_expired.retry_class: transient (gated by matures_at — wait then same retry)

amount_mismatch.retry_class: needs_input (recover the misfunded UTXO — funds are safe on-chain)
